config.label: exploratory
config.description: Throughput and seed-spread probe on the EXP-002 matrix shape at one fifth of the planned episodes, with seeds 100-109 disjoint from the confirmatory seeds 0-9 (exploratory)

metric_definitions.accuracy: proportion of agents with a_i = theta (0 to 1)
metric_definitions.cascade_any: 1 if at least one agent is in a cascade (0 or 1)
metric_definitions.wrong_cascade_any: 1 if at least one agent is in a cascade on the wrong action (0 or 1)
metric_definitions.longest_wrong_run: length of the longest run of consecutive incorrect actions (agents)
metric_definitions.informative_share: share of agents not in a cascade (0 to 1)
metric_definitions.action_entropy_bits: binary entropy of the within-episode action frequency (bits)
